prompt_set.prompt: Create a production composition painting based on the attached seed. Preserve its very specific gorgeous dark autumn hand-painted storybook brushwork, warm amber illuminated wooden cottage porch, black cat on left porch railing, jack-o-lanterns and iron candle lanterns lining the winding stone path, rusty leaves, dusky blue distant wooded lake and mountains, old foreground tree and timber fence. NO text. This is a single landscape-ish 4:3 master stage, at highest practical resolution. Re-stage intelligently for BOTH a central portrait crop and a wide landscape crop: place the cabin entrance near x58% y37%, the BLACK CAT perched visibly on railing at x40% y45% with complete tail hanging downward, keep main stairs y50-63%, pumpkins clustered near x42% y67% and x65% y68%, a prominent candle lantern at x65% y61%. The center vertical 42% width should make a complete portrait picture with roof at top and path at bottom; the full-width upper 75% should make a complete landscape picture with roof, cat, doorway and near pumpkins all visible. Cabin and cat a little larger than seed, appealing clear silhouettes. Place distant woods and lake in left outer area, foreground trunk at x12%, branch canopy overhead and framing edges. Wooden fence posts at edges; path continues to bottom. Empty rocking chair stays still just beside doorway. Full frame original richly detailed painting, natural perspective, modest gold light pools, dark shadows with readable paint, painted fine outlines, no photographic rendering, no fake bokeh. Retain the inviting Halloween identity without added creatures. This is a staging proof, not a collage or comparison sheet.

Precise production clean-plate edit of this image, exactly same 4:3 canvas dimensions and pixel registration. KEEP architecture, roof, windows, doors, porch railing/posts, stairs, stone path, distant landscape, left foreground tree and canopy, fences absolutely stationary and identical. REMOVE completely: the black cat including whole tail and body; the entire rocking chair and blanket; ALL pumpkins and jack-o-lanterns including the foreground left pumpkin; ALL portable iron lanterns and their flames (on steps, rocks, hanging on right foreground post, near pumpkins); ALL pots with flowers on ground or hanging by porch; the door wreath. Reconstruct clean continuous railing/window/porch floor behind cat, smooth matching wooden porch floor behind chair, appropriate unoccupied stone/soil/stairs behind pumpkins, lanterns and planters. Retain the three fixed wall sconces and glowing house windows unchanged. Remove only cast glow immediately associated with removed pumpkins or portable lanterns from nearby path stones, preserving warm window illumination. Absolutely no cat remnants, no tail, no pumpkin stems, no chair legs, no detached flowers. Keep natural fallen leaves scattered on path, vines on architecture. No new objects. This is repaired surroundings for independent cutouts; preserve detailed brushwork, paint color and fixed structure exactly. Output a single full image with no text.

Create a single 3 columns by 2 rows animation sprite atlas of the COMPLETE BLACK CAT from the attached autumn porch painting, with a genuinely transparent background, no scenery, no railing, no shadow card, no checkerboard paint, no text. Each of the 6 evenly spaced square cells holds the exact same whole seated black cat at the SAME SCALE and registered FEET at identical positions within each cell, complete ears, body, paws and hanging tail. Pose reference: body in three-quarter side view facing right, sitting on a narrow railing, all paws planted at a horizontal line about 68% of cell height, curved tail hangs down below paws to about90%, dark near-black fur with restrained warm amber rim lighting from right behind, small luminous golden eyes, hand-painted storybook brushwork, fine rough painted outline matching seed. Cat is an elegant cat, not round cartoon. Fixed seated body and feet across all cels, changing drawings ONLY in head/eyes/ears and hanging tail. Row-major sequence: 1 neutral gazing right-front tail hook to left; 2 head turned slightly more right/up watching drifting leaf, tail tip extends left; 3 head turned right/up a little further, alert ears, tail gently curls to right; 4 same as neutral with half-closed eyes, tail right curve; 5 eyes fully closed for blink, tail returns center-left; 6 eyes open neutral, tail returns first hook. The head turn should read as real different drawing but never a full-body rotation or size change. NO collars, no extra paws, no props. Leave generous transparent gutters, contain every tail and ear. Produce high resolution.

Production background reconstruction edit, single full 4:3 image SAME canvas and same perspective as reference. This is the bare environment behind the cottage and foreground framing. REMOVE the ENTIRE cottage, roof, chimney, windows, porch, stair structure, all architectural vines, all light fixtures; REMOVE both foreground wooden fences/posts and the massive foreground left tree trunk and overhead branch canopy. Fill their areas with a continuous believable dusky blue-gray mountain forest valley, cloudy blue evening sky above, distant dark pine silhouettes and a quiet lake visible middle-left, and rusty leaf-strewn sloping earth and stone path across bottom half. Preserve the original visible distant lake and hills at left and original visible bottom-center path geometry as precisely as possible, extending their painting naturally behind the removed objects. No buildings in near or middle distance, no pumpkins, lanterns, cats or furniture. Tiny remote lakeshore lights can remain. Match the dark painted autumn storybook brushwork and color of the reference, modest atmospheric depth and readable rich black-blue silhouettes, no photograph and no blur. No orange artificial illumination in newly exposed areas, the removed house supplied it. This will sit behind independent cottage, ground, and tree cutouts, so continuous hidden landscape matters more than making a new hero scene. No text.

Generate a single animation sprite sheet, 3 columns by 2 rows with equal square cells, showing SIX sequential hand-painted shapes of one dry rusty orange maple leaf tumbling in a gentle autumn breeze. Use the attached cottage painting only as STYLE and PALETTE reference. Isolated leaf only on an entirely uniform pure cyan background #00FFFF, with no shadows on the background, no gradients, no text, no checkerboard. Each cel leaf occupies the center 55% of its cell and has a thin curved stem, delicate dark painted vein marks, rough hand-painted outline. Six different orientations show a believable tumble: flat broad face diagonal, cupped oblique face, thin edge-on, reverse face, opposite oblique, then approaching original broad face. Rich dark red-brown and rusty gold paint matching the reference foreground maple leaves; no bright yellow neon, no photographic leaf. Equal visual scale in all cells; generous margins. This is real changing painted shape, not 6 identical flat leaves simply rotated. No other objects.

A technical animation atlas of a candle flame ONLY, 4 columns and 2 rows, eight evenly spaced rectangular cells, each containing one small hand-painted pale honey-gold flame with a white-yellow core and dark orange thin edge. Flame base at identical coordinate x50% y80% within each cell, height about45% of cell. Different graceful flame silhouettes across the sequence: upright, lean left, low left curve, upright short, lean right tall, low right curve, upright tall, upright medium. Use expressive storybook painted contours, restrained glow only immediately at the contour. Absolutely solid pure black background across the entire image (#000000), no gradient, no smoke, no candle wax or wick or holder, no reflections, no captions or panel lines. The black background will be converted deterministically into transparent emission. Identical scale, registered base, plenty of margin. The eight changing flame drawings form a quiet continuous combustion cycle.

Precise clean-plate correction of this attached painting. Keep the entire image, exact 1448x1086 composition, all geometry and all colors unchanged except THREE FIXED WALL LANTERNS: remove the glowing wall sconce at x~863 y~344, the one at x~1095 y~337, and the one at x~1153 y~334. Remove the whole iron fixture, luminous glass and hook, then paint continuous matching dark stone or wood directly behind each one. Reduce only the very local halo caused by those sconces; retain all window illumination. No new objects, no other removals, no layout change. Windows, vines, door, rails, roof, steps, tree, valley and path remain exactly in their original places. This is backing for independent fixture assets.

note: Raw outputs preserved. The cat had opaque checkerboard pixels and required deterministic matte extraction. Leaf and flame raw outputs contained native alpha. These facts were checked after generation rather than inferred from prompts.
